manifest.name: dsh-superagent
manifest.author: DeepSeek Harness Team <team@dsh.dev>
manifest.description: A proactive agent for one GitHub repository, as a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) bundle: it listens to GitHub and optionally Feishu, evaluates requests under a Policy, turns authorized ones into Tickets, and executes each in its own DSH Session.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

bundle.text:
# dsh-superagent bundle layer: inserts the plugins without configuration, and the agent presets its Sessions run under. The
# profile supplies the `dsh-superagent` entry's stateDir (see docs/006-deployment.md and examples/profile.cordis.patch.yml); the plugin
# refuses to start without stateDir.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-superagent
      name: dsh-superagent
    - id: dsh-superagent-github
      name: dsh-superagent/github-watch
    # Optional Feishu Source; requires configuring a bot CLI after enabling.
    - id: dsh-superagent-feishu
      name: dsh-superagent/feishu-watch
      disabled: true
    # Optional local-inbox Source; point its root at a directory of message files after enabling.
    - id: dsh-superagent-inbox
      name: dsh-superagent/inbox-watch
      disabled: true
    # The agent preset of every Executor Session (WORKER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts); the main Session has its own, below.
    # It is DSH's `standard` preset with only what a worker needs, and a shell whose foreground command moves to a background job
    # after 5 seconds, so a long command does not hold back a person's message, which the Session takes at its next step. Left
    # out: questions to a person, presenting, plan mode, the plugin manager and market, scheduling, goals, workflows, web fetch,
    # and forked subagents, which would run under this preset; spawned subagents run under `standard`, whose shell moves a
    # command to a background job only after 60 seconds, as a subagent's jobs are killed when it ends. A preset row has no
    # setting that hides it from the preset picker, so its name and description say whom it is for.
    - id: dsh-superagent-worker-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-superagent-worker
        name: dsh-superagent 执行器
        description: dsh-superagent 的执行器 Session 专用，不供手动选择。前台命令超 5 秒转入后台，只含执行工作所需的工具。
        order: 90
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          # A foreground command waits at most 5 s, then the shell tool moves it to a background job.
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          # A wait for a job ends after 5 s too; the job's end wakes the worker with its result.
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelection: true
                  modelDiscovery: true
                  agentPreset: standard
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: false
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
    # The agent preset of the main Session (ROUTER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts). The worker's 5-second shell and job waits, so a command or a wait does not hold back the next candidates, and
    # only what the main Session uses: no subagents, web, file search or writes, todo list, questions to a person, presenting,
    # plan mode, plugin manager, scheduling, goals or workflows. No persona: the main Session's prompt is complete, so it has
    # no other section.
    - id: dsh-superagent-router-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-superagent-router
        name: dsh-superagent 主 Session
        description: dsh-superagent 的主 Session 专用，不供手动选择。前台命令和任务等待超 5 秒转入后台，只含路由所需的工具。
        order: 91
        plugins:
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
            config:
              write: false
              edit: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

readme.text:
> 让 [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) 上的 [dsh-superagent](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype) **零外部依赖**跑起来：一个基于本地文件收件箱的 Source 插件。投放一条 JSON 消息，Super-agent 评估、建单、派出 Worker、把结果写回你的文件夹。

本项目是 dsh-superagent（DeepSeek Harness 团队的 Super-agent 研究原型）的**扩展发行版**：在官方 bundle 之上新增了 `inbox` Source 插件（`./inbox-watch`），其余代码保持上游原样，MIT 许可，出处见文末。

---

readme.section: 1. 背景：这套东西解决什么问题
readme.text:
DeepSeek Harness 团队在 2026-10-31 发布了文章 [《Super-agent 设计探索：迈向更自主的 Agent 系统》](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/zoS7GlReWPhfCjENGxXCdg)，并提出开源原型 dsh-superagent。其核心判断是：单任务 Coding Agent 已经可用，瓶颈转向**人的注意力**——一个人通常只能同时跟进 3–5 个活跃 Session。

Super-agent 用四个特征回应：**连续**（跨信道只有一个 Agent）、**高效**（多任务并发）、**主动**（事件驱动）、**持久**（异常自愈）。支撑它的五个模块：

readme.section: 1. 背景：这套东西解决什么问题
readme.text:
| 模块 | 一句话 |
|---|---|
| 双层架构 | Router 层常驻路由（只分派、不执行），Worker 层上下文隔离并发执行 |
| 事件驱动 | 环境事件即 Trigger；两级过滤（程序 Fast Path + 模型 Slow Path）、订阅直通、Inline & Spill、链式召回 |
| 面向人的交互 | 异步 ReAct Loop；多信道带宽匹配（IM ≤100 词硬上限，只在需要人时说话） |
| 存算分离 | Agent Loop 无状态化，Session 状态入库，执行环境留在原地（BYOM） |
| Watchdog | 主系统外部的 Control Loop，既查基础设施也查任务实质进展 |

官方原型内置 GitHub 与飞书两个 Source（事件来源），但都需要账号/机器人配置。**本项目新增的 `inbox` Source 补上"最后一公里"：任何有终端的人，用一个文件夹就能驱动整条 Trigger → Eval → Ticket → Worker → Channel 链路。**

```text
<root>/                      ← 面板里配置的收件箱根目录
  ops/                       ← 一个"对话"（conversation）
    in/                      ← 你把消息 JSON 投到这里
      done/                  ← 已被 Agent 接收的消息（自动移入，相当于读取游标）

```json
{
  "id": "m-001",              // 必填，对话内唯一（重放安全：Trigger id 由 conversation+id 派生）
  "from": "alice",            // 必填，发送者身份（进入 Policy 白名单判断）
  "text": "把设置页的保存按钮文案改成「保存更改」",

readme.section: 2.3 回复格式（出现在 `out/*.json`，文件名即消息 id，天然幂等）
2.4 与 Super-agent 领域模型的集成点
readme.text:
| 领域概念 | inbox 的映射 |
|---|---|
| Trigger | 一个消息文件；id = `key('inbox', conversation, id)`，重放安全 |
| Thread | `<conversation>:<根消息 id>`——同话题连续消息构成事件流，**订阅直通**由此生效 |
| Actor / Policy | `from` 进白名单；`to: agent` 即显式喊话（explicit 强度）；bot 消息最多成为推断候选 |
| Admission | 每个对话一行准入表：`mentions`（仅 @）或 `all`（全部消息） |
| Channel | 回复写 `out/`，以消息 id 幂等（`wx` 标志），永不"永久失败" |
| threadContext | 评估时读取该话题全部消息（含 Agent 回复，标记 bot），分页供链式召回 |
| Worker 环境变量 | `DSH_SUPERAGENT_INBOX_CONVERSATION` 告诉 Worker 工单来自哪个对话 |

readme.section: 2.4 与 Super-agent 领域模型的集成点
readme.text: 安全模型沿用 dsh-superagent 的完整 Policy：不在白名单里的人、bot、CI **不能授权工作**；白名单 + 显式喊话才产生 explicit 工单；观察性工作（auto 模式的规则匹配）只在你启用并写明规则后发生。

前置：DeepSeek Harness `dsh ^0.2.1-alpha.2`、Node `^22.19 || >=24`、pnpm。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JHOpenDev/dsh-superagent-inbox.git
cd dsh-superagent-inbox
pnpm install && pnpm check      # typecheck + 全部测试 + 构建 lib/
```

1. 按 [SETUP.md](SETUP.md) 完成 dsh-superagent 的基础部署（仓库、GitHub 账号；GitHub 账号是 Worker 提交 PR 用的，若只跑 inbox 也可以配一个最小权限账号）。
2. 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/`）中启用 inbox：

```yaml
- id: dsh-superagent
  config:
    stateDir: /home/me/.dsh/state/superagent
- id: dsh-superagent-inbox

3. 重启 Harness，打开 **Superagent 侧边栏面板 → Sources → Local inbox**，配置：
   - `root`：收件箱根目录（绝对路径）
   - `conversations`：至少一个对话，如 `{ id: "ops", listen: "mentions" }`
4. **Eval → On each Source → Local inbox**：把你自己（`from` 的值）加入 allowed 名单。

cat > $ROOT/ops/in/m-001.json <<'EOF'
{ "id": "m-001", "from": "alice", "to": "agent",
  "text": "把 README 的安装命令从 npm 改成 pnpm" }
EOF

readme.section: 4) 在同话题追问（thread: "m-001"）会直通该工单的 Worker，无需再 @
readme.text:
```

同话题后续消息（带 `thread` 字段）经**订阅直通**直达 Worker，不消耗 Router 判断；一段纯闲聊会被两级过滤安静丢弃（面板 Sources 页可见 `filtered` 审计）。

```text
pnpm check（typecheck + vitest + tsdown build）
1203 / 1204 通过；唯一失败项 environment.spec 的 git 报错文案断言，
系本机 git 2.42 文案与上游断言的差异，在未修改的上游基线上同样失败，与本插件无关。
新增 tests/inbox.spec.ts 7 项全绿：翻译/幂等游标/白名单强度/回复幂等/线程上下文分页/注册与健康/准入表。

同一套架构思想在 ZCode 上的移植（技能 + 斜杠命令实现：Router=主会话、Worker=后台子代理、订阅直通=SendMessage、Watchdog=巡检命令）。它不依赖本 bundle，安装方法见 [adapters/zcode-plugin/README.md](adapters/zcode-plugin/README.md)。两个实现的领域术语保持一致（Trigger/Thread/Ticket/Mandate/Watchdog），可作为"harness 无关的 Super-agent 架构"的对照样本。

- 架构与领域模型来自 DeepSeek Harness 团队的文章与实践：**《Super-agent 设计探索：迈向更自主的 Agent 系统》**（微信公众号「DeepSeek Harness 团队」，2026-10-31）与官方原型 [deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype)（MIT）。本仓库绝大部分代码属于他们——本项目的增量是 `src/sources/inbox.ts`、`tests/inbox.spec.ts`、bundle 接线与这份文档。
- 遵循原型的哲学：**尽可能少占用人的注意力，尽可能多地交付价值。** inbox Source 默认只接收配置过的对话、只让白名单里的人发起工作、只在需要人行动或结果可交付时写 `out/`。
